description: Bounded partial-deliverable scoring for selected active unfinished frozen criteria. Weights sum to fixed parent weight, never alter formal acceptance. Additional criteria require pre-reviewed milestone allocation; do not edit weights retrospectively. Additional November 6 source-observable milestones for expert physics, replay, HDMA moving pixels, character part identity and actual 2P physical QA; no partial completion automatically granted.

milestones.deliverable: Real original-player source observations and source-registered five-part GLB prototype are reproducible
milestones.limitation: Experimental geometry is not the recovered or shipping 1994 mesh.

milestones.deliverable: A single authored source-controlled part-addressable rig and reversible joint transformations are maintained
milestones.limitation: Prototype articulation does not establish authentic joint positions, pose correspondence or native runtime integration.

milestones.deliverable: Source-linked blue/red pose geometry is evaluated against independent original frames and retained holdout families
milestones.limitation: Higher IoU on some frames does not establish original physical 3D geometry.

milestones.deliverable: One coherent artifact is integrated with real Windows gameplay render under source-linked identities
milestones.limitation: Pages-only previews and external model experiments cannot satisfy runtime asset integration.

milestones.deliverable: The shared pose-registered production 3D geometry qualifies across required states
milestones.limitation: Final art approval and other ART criteria remain separate.

milestones.deliverable: Original silhouette and 24-frame source body references are independently reproducible
milestones.limitation: References and metrics alone do not establish correct authored proportions.

milestones.deliverable: Authentic 1994 sprite/manual projected 2D landmarks and occlusion are captured
milestones.limitation: Print 2D cannot prove original physical 3D dimensions or camera.

milestones.deliverable: One model meets prespecified blue/red silhouette and independent holdout thresholds
milestones.limitation: Local saddle/fork shape improvements are insufficient without independent generalization.

milestones.deliverable: Model remains rounded, distinctive and stable across genuine source poses
milestones.limitation: Rigid pose renders do not prove animation or 4K visual identity.

milestones.deliverable: Owner has seen and approved the original identity silhouette
milestones.limitation: Owner approval is separate from individual source-fit metrics.

milestones.deliverable: Direct-drive wheel/crank and frame/saddle mechanically linked around validated pivots
milestones.limitation: An in-memory experimental rig does not recover original joint animations.

milestones.deliverable: Original frame/phase registration supplies repeatable motion controls
milestones.limitation: Source phase observations are not themselves a 3D animation.

milestones.deliverable: Genuine chronological transitions do not introduce part overlap, mesh jumps or detachment
milestones.limitation: One static render per pose does not qualify continuity.

milestones.deliverable: Real game animation is driven by the unified source/rig with real gameplay controls
milestones.limitation: Pages motion previews do not count as runtime animation.

milestones.deliverable: Gameplay motion follows original source identity across full required transitions
milestones.limitation: User likeness review and art gate remain separate.

milestones.deliverable: Source moving-course camera/tile baseline and first divergence are reproduced
milestones.limitation: Diagnostics are not proof of correct source-world presentation.

milestones.deliverable: Screen/split-band raster rules and HDMA source phase are implemented and unit-tested
milestones.limitation: Isolated parser regressions alone do not qualify full moving course.

milestones.deliverable: Actual widened course tile streaming references pass source-bound comparisons
milestones.limitation: One checkpoint does not cover changing world/split states.

milestones.deliverable: Multiple authentic moving-camera/split frames match independently held reference conditions
milestones.limitation: Synthetic capture and recomputed expected images cannot substitute for source evidence.

milestones.deliverable: Integrated Windows x64 gameplay visual sequence qualifies full widescreen camera/tiles
milestones.limitation: Real physical 4K and other QA gates remain separate.

milestones.deliverable: Unique original USA course key, unchanged controller movie and original/source hashes are pinned
milestones.limitation: Preparatory harness evidence never grants event admission.

milestones.deliverable: First causally relevant original/native divergence is resolved or independently proven unobservable
milestones.limitation: Diagnostic internal byte equality is not sufficient.

milestones.deliverable: One full original/native genuine race result and scoring outcome pair passes same-run checks
milestones.limitation: Stage-only and synthetic guest results cannot count.

milestones.deliverable: Same-run progression, independent cold-save restart and artifact receipts agree
milestones.limitation: One accepted subpart is not a complete original event.

milestones.deliverable: All first-event criteria are accepted by a separate reviewer under the event census
milestones.limitation: Formal FID gate is authoritative; this partial record never changes it.

milestones.deliverable: Original expert race reference with same-run input, physics and course state is frozen
milestones.limitation: A handful of original time samples cannot demonstrate full interactive physics.

milestones.deliverable: Real native expert movement/physics source path is implemented against reference
milestones.limitation: Some supported movements do not establish all original expert state transitions.

milestones.deliverable: First semantic divergences are traced to bounded concrete causal effects and corrected
milestones.limitation: Diagnostic byte equality and unrelated source counter matches cannot stand in for gameplay behavior.

milestones.deliverable: Independent source/native expert run evidence meets predefined physical gameplay tolerances
milestones.limitation: One successful replay does not prove all race conditions or release gates.

milestones.deliverable: Representative complete expert-race physics behavior is qualified without source-semantic masking
milestones.limitation: Full formal criterion certification and accepted complete events are separate.

milestones.deliverable: Source-owned native saved run and source metadata reopen correctly from a cold process
milestones.limitation: A verified run file is not a replay or authenticated ghost playback.

milestones.deliverable: Cold-loaded replay/ghost decoder enforces original source run timing and identity
milestones.limitation: Decoding metadata alone does not render an authentic moving racer.

milestones.deliverable: Actual Modern UI starts, controls and exits ghost replay in integrated runtime
milestones.limitation: A synthetic menu path does not prove real persisted run animation.

milestones.deliverable: Real saved source-authentic run replays visibly with independently compared source outcomes
milestones.limitation: A simulated or patched fixture must not substitute for real source gameplay.

milestones.deliverable: Persistent saved replay is qualified across restart, profiles and relevant errors
milestones.limitation: An isolated successful replay never approves release QA.

milestones.deliverable: Source-authoritative moving HDMA and V0 original frame stream can be captured with immutable provenance
milestones.limitation: Source capture does not establish native or widened renderer fidelity.

milestones.deliverable: Actual runtime/native equivalent frames are captured at matching source checkpoints
milestones.limitation: Fixture-only or cross-epoch images cannot be counted as equivalent source frames.

milestones.deliverable: Independent deterministic pixel comparisons give causal mismatch diagnostics, not just similarity totals
milestones.limitation: Pixel differences may still indicate material graphical errors.

milestones.deliverable: Original and native representative moving camera, course, split, OBJ and brightness states qualify
milestones.limitation: A single source screenshot cannot cover scrolling dynamics.

milestones.deliverable: No unresolved substantive HDMA/V0 moving-frame parity failure survives source-bound comparison
milestones.limitation: Formal widening and hardware QA remain separate.

milestones.deliverable: Original 1994 material references for saddle, eye region, wheel/fork and axle parts are authenticated
milestones.limitation: Printed camera views and source sprites do not reveal ground-truth physical 3D dimensions.

milestones.deliverable: One source-authored model includes distinguishable adjustable saddle, forks, hub/rim, wheel and eyes
milestones.limitation: Experimental source geometry is not the approved final characteristic.

milestones.deliverable: Model character part identities hold across authenticated player roles and multiple genuine viewpoints
milestones.limitation: One camera-aligned static render may hide mechanical and silhouette faults.

milestones.deliverable: Relevant art parts remain correct when wheel and frame articulate in real source poses
milestones.limitation: Pages-only animation cannot substitute for integrated gameplay.

milestones.deliverable: Actual rendered 4K racer retains owner-approved source-specific part character
milestones.limitation: Owner art approval is separate and cannot be implied by source similarity.

milestones.deliverable: One source-pinned portable Windows 2P package passes independent actual-binary provenance
milestones.limitation: Hosted emulator or generated package is not real two-controller hardware.

milestones.deliverable: A physical Windows machine detects two actual controllers and their independent mappings
milestones.limitation: Device enumeration does not prove distinct playable P1/P2 inputs.

milestones.deliverable: Two local human-operated controllers produce a complete real guest race
milestones.limitation: One-pad synthetic automation or hosted 2P fixture is insufficient.

milestones.deliverable: Both players reach correct results and Modern menus using the same physical candidate
milestones.limitation: Simulated win or programmatic state jump is not a real physical journey.

milestones.deliverable: Independent physical 2P evidence is accepted against the exact nominated release candidate
milestones.limitation: A subtask credit never directly passes the formal QA-04 gate.
